description: x402-polyperp-candles: OHLCV candles for one Polymarket Perps market, with trend statistics computed for you — first open, last close, percent change, high, low, average volume, total trades and direction. Intervals: 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 1d, 1w. Use it for momentum, breakout and mean-reversion checks. Note these markets trade 24/7, so a daily candle covers the whole day for equities and commodities too — including the hours when the underlying cash market is shut.
name: x402-polyperp-candles
